name: Madagascar Centella Tone Brightening Capsule Ampoule 30ml
description:
Tone Brightening Capsule Ampoule

- Essence-like ampoule with encapsulated Madewhite™ that absorbs quickly, leaving a soft and non-sticky finish

- Madewhite™, a patented natural ingredient, provides radiance care for a brighter-looking complexion and leaves the skin with a natural glow

- Formulated with Niacinamide and Tranexamic Acid to provide tone-evening care

- Oil-in-Water-Gel Technology: This unique oil-and-water emulsion provides extended hydration, helping maintain skin moisture and leave it feeling soft and supple.
